works: Query tabs (id/name/sql/position/saved_id) persist via debounced (600ms) replace-all transactional tabs_save; restored on launch with blank fallback
App SQLite (WAL) in app-data dir; profiles as JSON blobs with position ordering; passwords in Keychain, never appdb

History: per-profile row (sql/ms/rows/ran_at UTC) on successful run; (profile_id, ran_at DESC) index; palette search (120ms debounce, limit 20); dashboard recent-8 across profiles with relative timestamps; clear all / older-than-7d actions
Saved queries CRUD linked to tabs via saved_id; ⌘S save-to-sidebar; rename keeps sidebar in sync
Closed-tab stack (cap 20) with ⌘⇧T restore; close guard prompts on uncommitted cell edits for ⌘W/click paths
Tab shortcuts wired: ⌘T/⌘W/⌘⇧T/⌃Tab/⌃⇧Tab/⌘1-9(0); tab context menu (Rename/Duplicate/Copy SQL/Close variants); inline rename; tx-open dot; kind icons
Additive migrations (tabs.saved_id, profiles.position) run idempotently at open; per-tab results keyed byTab so background streams can't corrupt the visible tab

gaps.title: Quit/reload loses the last ≤600ms of typing — debounced persist never flushed on close
gaps.detail: persist() (src/stores/tabs.ts:44-56) is the ONLY write path and it's a 600ms trailing debounce; there is no beforeunload handler, no Tauri onCloseRequested hook, and no flush-on-blur anywhere in src/ (grepped). Type SQL → ⌘Q immediately = the last edit burst silently gone; a tab created <600ms before quit vanishes entirely. Direct 'never lose work' charter violation a daily user hits daily. Fix: keep the debounce but add (a) window beforeunload → synchronous fire of the pending timer, (b) getCurrentWindow().onCloseRequested flush, (c) flush on window blur. Persist is tiny; flushing is cheap.

gaps.title: Failed tabs_list at startup → next persist WIPES all saved tabs (replace-all + no loaded gate)
gaps.detail: App.tsx:92 does `void useTabs.getState().load()` with no .catch. If tabs_list rejects (SQLITE_BUSY from a second instance — no busy_timeout is set in appdb.rs:47 — or transient IO), tabs=[] and loaded=false, but persist() (tabs.ts:45) has NO loaded guard: the user's first ⌘T/close action fires tabs_save, which is DELETE FROM tabs + insert current in-memory state (appdb.rs:169) — every previously saved tab is destroyed. Fix: (1) persist() returns early until loaded===true, (2) load() catches, retries with backoff, and surfaces an error state instead of silently starting empty, (3) `PRAGMA busy_timeout=2000` in AppDb::open.

gaps.title: tabs_save failures are silently swallowed — a whole session can silently never persist
gaps.detail: tabs.ts:54 `void invoke("tabs_save", ...)` — no .catch, no retry, no user-visible signal. If the appdb is locked/corrupt/disk-full, every save for the rest of the session fails invisibly and the user discovers the loss at next launch. Fix: .catch → bounded retry → sticky 'work not saving' toast/status-bar indicator (the app must never lie about persistence).

gaps.title: Failed/cancelled queries never enter history [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.35] execute.rs:70 propagates Err on any statement error → invoke rejects → results.ts:285 catch path skips the history_add at results.ts:277 (success-path only). Daily 'where did my typo query go'. Cancelled queries also vanish. Fix: history_add in finally with an `error TEXT`/`ok INTEGER` column (needs migration, see versioning gap); render failed rows red in palette/panel.

gaps.title: History records 0ms / undercounted rows due to Channel-vs-invoke race
gaps.detail: results.ts:276-284 reads `tabRes.totalMs ?? 0` and sums st.rowCount immediately after `await ipc.executeStream(...)` resolves — but Channel events (`finished`, trailing `rows` batches held in the rAF queue, results.ts:92-128) may not have flushed into the store yet. History intermittently logs ms=0 and low row counts — it lies about timing. Fix: capture ms/rows inside the `finished`/`statement_done` handlers and fire history_add from there.

gaps.title: history_search LIKE escaping is broken — searching SQL containing % or _ returns wrong results
gaps.detail: appdb.rs:206 builds `%{q.replace('%',"\\%")}%` but the LIKE has NO `ESCAPE '\'` clause, so `\%` matches a literal backslash + anything: searching for `LIKE '%foo` (a query the user actually ran) finds nothing. `_` is never escaped → single-char wildcard false positives. Fix: escape `\`, `%`, `_` and append `ESCAPE '\'` to the query.

gaps.title: Palette hides real history matches: cmdk re-filters on an 80-char prefix
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx:244 sets item value to `history ${id} ${sql.slice(0,80)}` while Command has shouldFilter (Palette.tsx:88) — rows the server matched beyond char 80 fail cmdk's client filter and disappear → 'No results' with matches in the DB. Fix: forceMount/keywords with the full match snippet, or exempt the History group from client filtering (it is already server-filtered).

gaps.title: No appdb schema versioning — migrations are `let _ = ALTER` that swallow ALL errors
gaps.detail: appdb.rs:80-82 ignores every ALTER failure, not just 'duplicate column' (disk-full/locked/readonly also vanish), and there is no PRAGMA user_version, so every future schema change (error flag on history, tab meta, widths) must be another idempotent-ALTER hack ordered by hope. Fix: read `PRAGMA user_version`, run a numbered migration Vec inside a transaction, bump the version; only tolerate the specific duplicate-column error message.

gaps.title: tabs schema rigidity blocks all planned per-tab state (cursor, scroll, pin, kind)
gaps.detail: TabRow (appdb.rs:12-20) is fixed columns; adding anything means Rust struct + ALTER + commands.rs + tabs.ts persist/load all hand-synced. Roadmap already needs: active-tab persist, pinned flag, cursor/scroll restore, column widths. Fix: add `meta TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` JSON column (mirrors the profiles.data pattern) and route new per-tab state through it; keep hot columns (sql, position) as-is.

gaps.title: One corrupt profile row bricks ALL connections
gaps.detail: appdb.rs:97-99: list_profiles aborts with Err on the first serde_json parse failure → profiles_list fails → dashboard/rail render zero connections and connect-by-history breaks, because of one bad row (e.g. a future field added without #[serde(default)], or partial write). Fix: skip unparseable rows, log them, return the rest; optionally surface 'N profiles could not be read'.

gaps.title: Two app instances silently clobber each other's tabs; no busy_timeout
gaps.detail: No tauri-plugin-single-instance; tabs_save is replace-all last-writer-wins, so an accidentally opened second window erases the first window's tab changes at its next debounce tick. Plus no `PRAGMA busy_timeout` (appdb.rs:47) means concurrent access errors instantly instead of waiting. Fix: single-instance plugin (focus existing window) + busy_timeout.

gaps.title: Active tab not persisted — every launch lands on tab 0 [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.5] tabs.ts:79 `activeId: tabs[0].id`. A 12-tab daily user re-hunts their tab every morning. Fix: store active tab id (appdb key-value or tabs.meta) and restore; falls out nearly free once the meta column exists.

gaps.title: Table tabs vanish on restart [known — locked decision, still a daily loss]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 decision #5] persist() filters kind==='table' (tabs.ts:52); a browse session with 5 table tabs reopens as query tabs only. Locked to protect cold-start, but the middle ground is unbuilt: persist the table ref (schema.table + profile) and restore as a LAZY placeholder tab that connects on first focus — zero cold-start cost.

gaps.title: Window geometry not persisted [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.5] hardcoded 1240×800; every launch forgets size/position/display. Fix: tauri-plugin-window-state.

gaps.title: No dedicated history panel: timestamps fetched but never shown anywhere searchable [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.5] History is palette-only: Palette.tsx:249 renders rows·ms but NOT ran_at (fetched and dropped); no profile column in a multi-profile day, no error status, no re-run-in-place vs open-in-new-tab choice, no copy-SQL right-click, no pagination past limit 20, no date grouping (Today/Yesterday). Fix: sidebar History section or ⌘Y panel over history_search with timestamps, profile chips, error badges, copy/re-run context menu, infinite scroll.

gaps.title: History has no dedup/grouping — one hot query drowns the list
gaps.detail: Running the same SELECT 50 times inserts 50 identical rows (appdb.rs:180); palette's 20-row window fills with duplicates hiding older distinct queries. TablePlus/DataGrip collapse repeats. Fix: display-collapse consecutive identical sql, or schema change to UNIQUE(profile_id, sql-hash) + last_ran_at + run_count (needs migration framework).

gaps.title: History growth unbounded + unbounded per-row SQL size [known, plus size angle]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.35 lists the row-count cap] No retention (appdb.rs:180); additionally an 8MB pasted INSERT statement is stored verbatim on EVERY run — qwry.sqlite bloats and every palette LIKE scan drags it. Fix: retention cap (last N per profile, pruned in history_add) + truncate stored sql at ~64KB with an ellipsis marker; consider FTS5 for search.

gaps.title: "Clear history (all)" only clears the active profile [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.35] Palette.tsx:149 passes activeProfileId; appdb.rs:289 filters by it. Label lies. Fix: relabel to 'Clear history (this connection)' + add a true global clear (profile_id IS NULL branch).

gaps.title: closeOthers/closeToRight/closeAll bypass the close guard — staged edits silently discarded [known]
gaps.detail: [known — tabs.ts:36 comment says 'see ROADMAP followup'] tabs.ts:142-172 call closeTab directly, skipping useCloseGuard.request; a tab with uncommitted cell edits is destroyed without the Esc/Enter/⌘↵ prompt that ⌘W gives. Fix: route each id through requestClose sequentially (await each decision), or one aggregate prompt listing dirty tabs.

gaps.title: Rename tab silently overwrites the linked saved query's SQL with the unsaved draft
gaps.detail: tabs.ts:206-209: rename() upserts {id: saved_id, name, sql: t.sql} — if the tab's sql diverged from the saved version, a mere rename pushes the draft into the sidebar entry without consent (and there's no undo). Fix: rename should update name only; sql updates stay exclusive to ⌘S saveActive.

gaps.title: Restore-closed loses table tabs, saved_id links, and dies on restart
gaps.detail: tabs.ts:118-121 only remembers tabs with non-empty sql → closed table tabs are unrestorable via ⌘⇧T; tabs.ts:199 restores via newTab(sql,name) dropping saved_id (restored tab no longer syncs with its sidebar entry); closedStack is memory-only so the undo-close safety net vanishes every launch. Fix: stack entries carry {kind, table, saved_id}; persist the stack (bounded) in appdb.

gaps.title: No middle-click close on tabs
gaps.detail: TabBar.tsx:72-129 tab div has no onAuxClick — middle-click-to-close is universal muscle memory (browsers, TablePlus, editors). Fix: onAuxClick e.button===1 → requestClose(t.id).

gaps.title: No drag-to-reorder tabs
gaps.detail: Tab order is frozen at creation order; TabBar.tsx has no DnD and the store has no move(id, toIndex). Every mature client reorders tabs (roadmap only lists Pin). Fix: pointer-based drag on .tab with a move action; persist() already recomputes positions so persistence is free.

gaps.title: IPC type-sync drift: HistoryRow re-declared locally, TabRow has no TS mirror, QueryEvent missing Notice
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx:29-35 re-declares HistoryRow (already omits profile_id) instead of importing ipc/types.ts; Rust TabRow (appdb.rs:12) has no entry in types.ts — tabs.ts:76 fakes it with Omit<Tab,...> so a Rust field change type-checks green while breaking at runtime; types.ts QueryEvent lacks the Notice variant ARCHITECTURE.md specifies. Fix: adopt ts-rs or specta to generate types.ts from the Rust structs (kills the whole hand-sync class); at minimum export TabRow and delete local duplicates.

gaps.title: History is blind to database and orphaned by profile deletion; DB-switcher clones fragment it
gaps.detail: history rows key only profile_id (appdb.rs:61-68); clone_connection (commands.rs:59) mints a new profile per database so one logical server's history shards across clones and palette search (active profile only) can't see siblings; delete_profile (appdb.rs:135) leaves that profile's history forever unreachable (clear is active-profile-only) and Dashboard renders '—' for it (Dashboard.tsx:119). Fix: store dbname in history; on profile delete, delete (or re-parent) its history; palette option to search across a clone family/all profiles.

gaps.title: Editor cursor/scroll/undo per tab not restored (in-session or across restart)
gaps.detail: Only sql text round-trips (tabs.ts:80,92); switching tabs rebuilds the doc via setSql so caret/scroll/undo history reset, and restart loses them entirely — TablePlus/DataGrip land you exactly where you were. Fix: per-tab CodeMirror EditorState cache in-session; persist {anchor, head, scrollTop} in the tabs meta column for restart.

gaps.title: Column widths / grid state not persisted [known]
gaps.detail: [known — ROADMAP_v0.5 v0.5] widths reset every run/reopen; no appdb surface exists for them. Fix: small key-value map keyed by table-oid or query-shape hash in appdb (rides the migration framework).

gaps.title: Out-of-order persist race: older tabs snapshot can overwrite newer
gaps.detail: tabs.ts:54 fires invoke without awaiting; two in-flight tabs_save calls (600ms apart under load) run on Tauri's sync-command thread pool with no ordering guarantee — a stale snapshot can commit last. Rare but silent. Fix: chain saves through a single in-flight promise (queue latest, drop intermediates).

gaps.title: Tab names never deduplicated; ⌘1-9 targets are unguessable; ⌘0 convention wrong
gaps.detail: Every new tab is 'new qwry' (tabs.ts:60) — five identical names defeat ⌘1-9 (App.tsx:136-140), and ⌘0 selects tab 10 where macOS convention is last-tab. Fix: auto-number ('new qwry 2'), ⌘9/⌘0 → last tab, show the index in the tab tooltip.

gaps.title: No dirty-vs-saved indicator on tabs linked to saved queries
gaps.detail: ARCHITECTURE wireframe promises 'orders.sql ●' but TabBar.tsx renders no divergence marker when tab.sql !== saved sql — the user can't tell what ⌘S would change. Fix: compare against useSaved entry and render a dot; also give ⌘S on an empty/table tab some feedback instead of silently returning (tabs.ts:217).

gaps.title: Palette history items: no timestamp, no full-SQL preview, no copy affordance
gaps.detail: Palette.tsx:241-253 shows a 90-char single line + rows·ms; ran_at is dropped, long SQL is unidentifiable, and there's no way to copy without opening a tab. Fix: relative-time on the right, ⌘-hover tooltip or footer preview of full SQL, and an alt-action (⌘↵ = copy SQL / ↵ = open in tab).

gaps.title: History/saved-queries not exportable; appdb location undocumented
gaps.detail: No export of history or saved queries (deferred in roadmap), and qwry.sqlite's path isn't surfaced anywhere in-app — users can't back up or migrate machines confidently, which undercuts 'never lose work' trust. Fix: 'Export saved queries / history' JSON + a Settings row revealing the app-data path in Finder.

perf_risks: history_search runs LIKE '%q%' (unindexable) full-table scans per palette keystroke (120ms debounce) over an unbounded, uncapped-row-size history table — with months of usage this hits hundreds of ms per keypress; needs retention cap + sql-length cap, or FTS5 (appdb.rs:192-220, Palette.tsx:54-64)

Single Mutex<Connection> serializes ALL appdb work (appdb.rs:41): a slow history scan blocks concurrent history_add and tabs_save on Tauri's sync-command threads — persistence stalls behind search at scale

tabs_save is replace-all: every 600ms debounce tick rewrites EVERY tab's full SQL text (DELETE + N inserts, appdb.rs:166-178); with a few large scratchpad tabs (500KB+ pasted SQL) that's megabytes of JSON serialization on the JS thread plus WAL churn per pause — switch to dirty-tab upsert or move serialization off the hot path
persist() itself maps/filters/serializes all tabs on the UI thread each tick (tabs.ts:45-56) — O(total sql bytes) IPC payload; fine at 10 small tabs, degrades with giant docs

useConnections.subscribe in tabs.ts:231 fires on EVERY connections-store change (each keystroke, each conn-state churn) and rebuilds the tabs array on sql changes; TabBar subscribes to the full tabs array so it re-renders per keystroke [known narrow-selector roadmap item]
closeOthers/closeAll do N sequential closeTab store writes → N TabBar re-renders + a burst of N disconnect IPC calls (tabs.ts:142-172); batch into one set() + one disconnect sweep
Tab strip smooth scrollIntoView animates on every tab switch (TabBar.tsx:34) [known — violates never-animate-scroll]

history_recent/history_search return full unbounded sql TEXT per row across IPC; one 8MB stored statement makes the dashboard recent-8 fetch a multi-MB JSON deserialize at startup — truncate at write or SELECT substr()
